build_decoder_subclass: build a python module that creates a new decoder subclass extending DecoderBase for a custom dataset
create_mnist_decoder: create a ColorMnistMLPDecoder instance with observation variance to reconstruct Color MNIST images from latent samples
compute_data_fidelity: compute the data fidelity reconstruction loss between input data and reconstructions using DecoderBase data_fidelity method
review_decoderbase_call: review the DecoderBase abstract call method that reconstructs data from latent samples of shape batch_size by latent_dim
refactor_mnist_hidden_units: refactor the ColorMnistMLPDecoder to change the hidden unit tuple from four 200-unit layers to a custom architecture
